TaskDescription: Non-REM sleep stage N3. Up to 10 minutes of artifact-free data (Non-REM sleep 20-min dataset of the MNI Open iEEG Atlas; von Ellenrieder et al. 2020).
InstitutionName: Montreal Neurological Institute (MNI Open iEEG Atlas); multicentre data from three tertiary epilepsy centres (Frauscher et al. 2018, Brain 141:1130), coded G, M and N in the channel names

AntiAliasLowPass_and_Resampling.Description: Resampled to 200 samples/s (unless that was the original rate) after a low-pass anti-aliasing filter at 80 Hz (source readme_NREMsleep.txt, Preprocessing 1).

PerSegmentMeanRemoval.Description: Mean of each segment and channel subtracted (source readme_NREMsleep.txt, Preprocessing 3).

iEEGReference: Bipolar montage between adjacent contacts of the same electrode (each channel is a bipolar derivation; source: one bipolar channel per column).
ElectrodeManufacturer: Montreal Neurological Institute homemade intracerebral electrodes
